description: Thirty-eight reviewed additions layered over the frozen 37-case consumed calibration baseline. The composite corpus has 75 cases and fills previously absent labels plus additional Task 1-3 long-input boundaries.

cases.scenario: The same recipient, data category, and approval state are explicit.

input.left: Send the diagnosis to the agency before approval.
input.right: Do not send the diagnosis to the agency before approval.

expected.label: YES
expected.rationale: The same transfer is both required and prohibited in the same scope.

cases.scenario: The paragraph mentions the advisor and the external reviewer before a plural-looking role is used loosely in conversation.

input.left: The external reviewer must not see participant names.
input.right: They may inspect participant names when checking recruitment records.

expected.label: MAY
expected.rationale: The pronoun may denote the reviewer or another actor; that referent controls the conflict.

cases.scenario: Prototype stages are explicit and sequential.

input.left: Use paper sketches during formative exploration.
input.right: Use an interactive prototype during the final evaluation.

expected.label: NO
expected.rationale: The directives govern different project phases and can both hold.

cases.scenario: A campus bulletin distinguishes visitors from construction personnel and distinguishes public opening hours from contractor access windows. Compare only the selected rules.

input.left: During public hours, visitors must use the south entrance because the main entrance is closed for façade work. This visitor rule does not authorize access to fenced work zones.
input.right: Before public opening, registered construction personnel may enter the fenced work zone through the service gate after the site supervisor verifies their badge.

expected.label: NO
expected.rationale: Audience, entrance, time, and destination scopes differ explicitly.

cases.scenario: Two preferences can change independently.

input.source: 사용자는 조용한 식당을 선호하고 예약 변경은 문자로 받기를 원한다.

expected.label: COMPOSITE
expected.rationale: Restaurant noise and appointment communication are independent preferences.

cases.scenario: One permission includes its sole exception.

input.source: 학생은 오후 5시 이후 출입할 수 없지만 승인된 야간 수업 참가자는 예외다.

expected.label: ATOMIC
expected.rationale: The exception defines the scope of one access rule.

cases.scenario: Punctuation loss makes list membership uncertain.

input.source: methods interviews prototype maybe field no lab and reviewers

expected.label: UNRESOLVED
expected.rationale: The fragment does not reveal reliable commitment or list boundaries.

cases.scenario: A bulletin paragraph bundles independently maintainable changes.

input.source: 공사 기간에는 Main Building 정문이 오후 5시에 닫히고, accessible ramp는 전면 폐쇄되며, Campus Store 주문 수령 장소는 도서관 로비로 이전한다. 단, 남문 accessible entrance의 운영시간은 변경되지 않는다.

expected.label: COMPOSITE
expected.rationale: Entrance hours, ramp state, pickup location, and unchanged south access are independently revisable.

cases.scenario: A requirement retains its strength.

input.translation: The participant recruitment criteria must be stated.

expected.label: PRESERVED
expected.rationale: The obligation and object are retained.

cases.scenario: The construction period limits validity.

expected.label: LOSSY
expected.rationale: The construction-only time condition was omitted.

cases.scenario: Approval polarity changes.

expected.label: CONTRADICTED
expected.rationale: The prohibition was reversed into an instruction.

cases.scenario: The source itself has an unresolved antecedent.

input.translation: Send the record if the doctor approves it.

expected.label: UNKNOWN
expected.rationale: The source does not establish who the person is or what is approved, so equivalence cannot be decided safely.

cases.scenario: A healthcare disclosure guardrail contains recipient, purpose, duration, and separate-category approval conditions.

input.source: 정부 의료기관이 진료 일정과 가족 연락처를 요청하면 정확한 수신자, 이용 목적, 보관 기간을 먼저 표시하고 두 범주를 각각 승인받은 뒤 승인된 범주만 전송하라. 응급 상황이라는 일반 문구만으로 승인을 추정하지 마라.
input.translation: When a government healthcare agency requests appointment and family information, show the recipient and ask for approval before sending the information.

expected.label: LOSSY
expected.rationale: The translation loses purpose, retention, per-category approval, approved-only minimization, and the no-inferred-emergency-approval boundary.

cases.scenario: Both Memories prescribe the primary research-question form.

input.left: Use a directional hypothesis as the primary research question.
input.right: Use an open qualitative question, not a directional hypothesis, as the primary research question.

expected.label: CONFLICT
expected.rationale: They select incompatible forms for the same primary slot.

cases.scenario: There are two entrances in the active frame.

input.right: The main entrance closes at 5 p.m.

expected.label: UNKNOWN
expected.rationale: Equivalence depends on whether the underspecified entrance is the main entrance.

cases.scenario: Different methods answer complementary questions.

input.right: Interview participants about the causes of interaction failures.

expected.label: COMPATIBLE
expected.rationale: Performance and explanatory evidence can be combined.

cases.scenario: Same operational hours in different notation.

input.left: The desk operates from 10:00 to 16:00 on weekdays.
input.right: On weekdays, the desk is open between 10 a.m. and 4 p.m.

expected.label: EQUIVALENT
expected.rationale: The weekday interval and operation state match.

cases.scenario: Both Memories are personal and mention planning, but their independently useful predicates differ.

input.left: Because loud restaurants make conversation difficult, the user prefers that restaurant suggestions be checked for a quiet environment before a family dinner is planned.
input.right: Because medical scheduling calls are stressful, the user prefers appointment changes by text message and wants the sender identity shown in the message.

expected.label: DISTINCT
expected.rationale: Dining-environment planning and medical communication channel preferences are independently revisable.

cases.scenario: A verified source explicitly retires the whole standalone notice.

input.source: The East Gate detour ended. Remove the standalone detour notice.
input.target: The East Gate shuttle follows a detour until further notice.

expected.label: REMOVE
expected.rationale: The source explicitly retires the entire target Memory.

cases.scenario: The source is an unverified overheard statement and the target is official guidance.

input.source: Someone said Lot C might be open now.
input.target: Accessible visitor parking is in Lot A during construction.

expected.label: UNRESOLVED
expected.rationale: Authority and certainty are insufficient for a safe replacement.

cases.scenario: The target already includes the same guardrail and exception.

input.source: Do not send family contacts without separate approval, including during urgent requests.
input.target: Family contact details require separate approval before transmission, even when a request is marked urgent.

expected.label: ALREADY_PRESENT
expected.rationale: The prohibition and urgent-request boundary are already represented.

cases.scenario: A verified bulletin changes one time field.

input.source: The visitor desk now closes at 4 p.m.
input.target: The visitor desk closes at 5 p.m.

expected.label: EDIT
expected.rationale: The same desk schedule is superseded.

cases.scenario: A verified bulletin contains a new independently actionable accessibility service; the supplied target candidate is related only by building and construction period.

input.source: During Main Building construction, visitors who cannot use stairs may request an escort from the south accessible entrance to the temporary service counter between 10:00 and 16:00 on weekdays. The request must be made at the entrance desk.
input.target: During Main Building construction, the third-floor rear route to the library is closed.

expected.label: ADD
expected.rationale: Escort service and route closure are independent propositions; the new service has no matching target.

cases.scenario: The unit asserts a current world state.

input.text: The south entrance remains open during construction.

expected.label: FACT
expected.rationale: It asserts facility state without directing future behavior.

cases.scenario: The unit is an input-output correction example.

input.text: When the request says 'family contacts only', expected: share no appointment dates.

expected.label: MEMORY
expected.rationale: It pairs a concrete input condition with an expected output boundary.

cases.scenario: The unit constrains future action.

input.text: Transmit only the categories explicitly approved for this recipient.

expected.label: RULE
expected.rationale: It is a reusable behavioral constraint.

cases.scenario: The unit asks for a missing disclosure condition.

input.text: How long will the receiving agency retain the information?

expected.label: QUESTION
expected.rationale: It requests missing retention information.

cases.scenario: Classify only the selected independently reviewable unit. It is a synthetic correction target, not evidence that a real proposal was submitted.

input.transcript: User: I want both advisors represented. Agent: Should every disagreement be flattened? User: No, preserve true conflicts for review.
input.selected_unit: Input: Advisor 1 requires a controlled study while Advisor 2 requires field deployment as the primary evaluation. Expected: mark one primary-method conflict and ask the user to choose; do not merge them as compatible.

expected.label: MEMORY
expected.rationale: The selected unit is a concrete input-expected-output example.

cases.scenario: Cross-Context content shares no operational predicate.

input.right: The agency retains submitted records for 30 days.

expected.label: DISTINCT
expected.rationale: Personal dining preference and external retention policy are independent.

cases.scenario: One Context distinguishes two entrances; the other omits the modifier.

input.right: The staff entrance closes at 5 p.m.

expected.label: UNKNOWN
expected.rationale: The underspecified entrance may or may not denote the staff entrance.

cases.scenario: The building has a visitor desk and a separate security desk; one Context omits the modifier.

input.right: The visitor desk closes at 4 p.m.

expected.label: UNKNOWN
expected.rationale: Equivalence depends on whether the underspecified desk denotes the visitor desk or the security desk.

cases.scenario: Two equal-authority advisor Contexts agree on users, prototype, interviews, and ethics. The selected relation concerns only the primary contribution claim.

input.left: Frame the primary HCI contribution as a conceptual model connecting observed user behavior to design choices; actionable recommendations may be secondary implications of the model.
input.right: Frame the primary HCI contribution as actionable design guidance that practitioners can apply; a conceptual model may support the explanation but must not be the primary contribution.

expected.label: CONFLICT
expected.rationale: They assign incompatible artifacts to the same primary-contribution role.

cases.scenario: The whole Memory is one requested preference.

expected.label: REMOVE
expected.rationale: The entire Memory is in scope.

cases.scenario: One sentence contains requested and independent facts.

input.request: Forget who keeps my spare key.
input.memory: The user's aunt keeps the spare key, and the user prefers appointment changes by text.

expected.label: EDIT
expected.rationale: Remove the key-holder fact and preserve the independent communication preference.

cases.scenario: The request concerns restaurant experiences; the candidate is a detailed healthcare disclosure policy with no dining content.

input.request: Forget every memory about noisy restaurants and family dinners.
input.memory: Before transmitting healthcare information, show the exact recipient, purpose, requested categories, and retention period; obtain separate approval for each category and preserve a receipt of the approved transfer.

expected.label: KEEP
expected.rationale: The Memory is unrelated to restaurants or family dining events.

cases.scenario: New information is tentative and conflicts with official content.

input.new_info: I heard the main entrance may stay open later.
input.memory: The main entrance closes at 5 p.m. during construction.

expected.label: UNRESOLVED
expected.rationale: Tentative hearsay cannot safely supersede the official schedule.

cases.scenario: The same condition and action are paraphrased.

input.new_info: Show the recipient before any transfer.
input.memory: Before transmitting information, display who will receive it.

expected.label: NO_CHANGE
expected.rationale: The recipient-before-transfer requirement is already present.

cases.scenario: A reviewed decision changes the primary evaluation while preserving secondary explanatory interviews.

input.new_info: The team has decided that the primary evaluation will be a four-week field deployment with usage logs; short follow-up interviews will remain as secondary explanatory evidence.
input.memory: The primary evaluation will be a controlled laboratory usability study, followed by short interviews that explain observed interaction failures.

expected.label: EDIT
expected.rationale: The same primary-evaluation commitment is superseded while the retained interview component can remain in the edited Memory.
